themeStates.title: Theme States
themeStates.description: Runtime switches for visual QA. Each token slice will add its state matrix here.
themeStates.buttonMatrixDesc: Covers 11 base button variants plus loading, disabled, and icon button states.
themeStates.fieldMatrixDesc: Covers default, focus, invalid, disabled, read-only, addon, and popup states for base field controls.
themeStates.fieldDefaultDesc: The default state uses the current Field tokens.
themeStates.fieldDisabledDesc: Disabled fields cannot be interacted with and use muted colors.
themeStates.step8MatrixDesc: Covers open, selected, highlighted, and danger states for popup surfaces, options, and menu items.
themeStates.overlayDesc: Popover / Select / Menu share overlay border, background, and shadow tokens.
themeStates.step6MatrixDesc: Covers tabs, checkbox, radio, switch, skeleton, and empty states.
themeStates.tabOverviewContent: Segmented tabs keep the selected state neutral.
themeStates.tabMetricsContent: Line tabs keep the animated indicator and use Tabs tokens.
themeStates.animatedTabMembersContent: AnimatedTabs uses the moving indicator only, avoiding duplicate active lines.
themeStates.animatedTabLogsContent: Keyboard navigation, aria-selected, and the animated indicator must all stay intact.
themeStates.emptyDesc: No data is available for the current filters.
themeStates.step7MatrixDesc: Covers table header, selected/expanded rows, side list active state, and current pagination.
themeStates.dataTableStates: DataTable four states (skeleton+pill / error banner / active sort / column resize)
themeStates.dataTableErrorBanner: Error: dimmed stale rows + banner under the header
themeStates.dataTableErrorBannerText: Failed to load the list: service unavailable
themeStates.dataTableSorting: Active sort: only the sorted column shows an arrow
themeStates.fileDropzoneHint: Common documents and images are supported
themeStates.badgeMatrixDesc: Seven semantic variants shown with and without the status dot; geometry and typography are token-driven, with Sera using transparent bare text.
themeStates.avatarMatrixDesc: Covers single avatar, status dot, avatar group, and count slot; background, foreground, status dot, and ring all use --avatar-* tokens.
themeStates.cardMatrixDesc: Full Card structure (Header/Title/Description/Action/Content/Footer); geometry is token-driven, with Sera using larger spacing and a lighter shadow.
themeStates.cardDescription: Card description copy rendered in the secondary text color.
themeStates.cardContent: Card body region; padding and radius follow the --card-spacing / --card-radius hooks.
themeStates.dialogMatrixDesc: DialogTitle typography follows the --title-* hooks (shared with CardTitle); static inline preview, none/normal by default with zero visual change, sera batch 2 delivers uppercase.
themeStates.dialogDescription: This action cannot be undone and permanently removes the member and their permissions.
themeStates.labelMatrixDesc: Label typography follows the --label-* hooks; labels next to a checkbox/radio/switch use the peer exemption (narrowed: only transform+tracking are reset). Sera applies uppercase typography.
themeStates.crosscutMatrixDesc: Empty states, skeletons, error screens, interrupt banners, confirmation tiers, toasts, form feedback and permission degrade — aligned with the StateEmpty / StateError / FormFeedback / PermDegrade boards
themeStates.emptyVariantNote: Each of the three has its own copy and action — mixing them is the most common mistake
themeStates.emptyFirstUseDesc: Create the first user, or bulk import from an existing system. Templates support Excel and CSV.
themeStates.emptyNoResultDesc: The 3 active filters have no overlap. Try removing “Role: Auditor”, or clear them all.
themeStates.emptyNoPermissionTitle: Your data scope cannot see these records
themeStates.emptyNoPermissionDesc: Current scope: this department and below (Finance). No users under it are visible to you — ask an administrator to widen the scope.
themeStates.skeletonRowsNote: Skeleton bars stay inside the data area; header and toolbar keep real content
themeStates.error403Title: You do not have access to this page
themeStates.error403Desc: Requires sys:role:view. Your current role (Finance clerk) does not include it.
themeStates.error404Desc: User EMP-0412 does not exist and may have been deleted. Bookmarked links can expire.
themeStates.error500Title: Something went wrong on our side
themeStates.error500Desc: The request was logged and the team has been alerted. Retry later, or send the id below to an admin.
themeStates.interruptNote: Interruptions use an in-page banner, never a full error page — a full page would discard what the user has typed. All three share one slot and only one shows at a time.
themeStates.interruptExpired: Your session expired, sign in again to continue
themeStates.interruptRestored: Reconnected — everything you typed is still here
themeStates.confirmSeverityNote: Reversible → confirm directly; has impact → put the impact in the button label; irreversible → type the name, confirm stays disabled until it matches
themeStates.confirmReversibleDesc: You have unsaved changes and they will be lost.
themeStates.confirmImpactDesc: They will not be able to sign in. Their 1 role is kept; 3 open tasks need to be handed over.
themeStates.confirmIrreversibleDesc: This cannot be undone. The role has 0 users and 12 permissions attached.
themeStates.confirmIrreversibleLabel: Type the role name to confirm
themeStates.toastNote: Top centre of the content area, at most 3 stacked. Success dismisses after 3s; errors never dismiss on their own.
themeStates.toastError: Save failed: employee id already taken
themeStates.toastWarning: Saved, but 2 roles were not applied due to insufficient permissions
themeStates.formFeedbackNote: Errors sit right under the field, never in a tooltip; uniqueness clashes name the conflicting record
themeStates.formFieldCodeError: This id is already taken by “Lin Xiaoyu”
themeStates.formSummaryTitle: 3 items need fixing before you can submit
themeStates.permDegradeNote: Front-end permissions are not a security boundary — every one of these must be checked again on the server
themeStates.permActionHiddenNote: Ordinary buttons are hidden when denied — nothing is rendered here
themeStates.permActionReason: Requires sys:user:delete, which your role does not include
themeStates.softControlsMatrixDesc: Light neumorphism: recessed track + raised thumb, light from top-left; independent from Switch / Tabs, driven by --soft-* tokens.
